technique_name: Make a speech about why consideration for the environment is important.
description:
Good morning everyone! 
Today, I’d like to talk about why consideration for the environment is so important. Every day, we are consuming vast amounts of the Earth’s natural resources just to meet our own demands. The global climate crisis is a direct consequence of this careless use of materials, energy, and resources.
